1. **Safety of metformin in chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a systematic review and meta-analysis.**
   Authors: Silvana Patiño-Cardona, Carlos Pascual-Morena, Irene Sequí-Domínguez, Celia Álvarez-Bueno, Héctor Martínez-Martínez, Mar de Miguel-Brox, Susana Priego-Jiménez, Vicente Martínez-Vizcaíno
   Journal: European journal of pharmacology
   Publication Date: 2026-02-05
   PMID: 41548682
   Abstract: Metformin is the mainstay treatment for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), but its use in chronic kidney disease (CKD) remains controversial because of concerns about lactic acidosis. Previous meta-analyses have been limited by heterogeneous comparator groups and lack of CKD-stage stratification.
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41548682/
